rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere
rules.description: A protected resource crosses its intended trust or control boundary and becomes accessible to an unintended actor.

rules.cwe_name: Permissive Cross-domain Security Policy with Untrusted Domains
rules.description: Cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) policy allows overly broad access.

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
rules.description: If the 'X-Frame-Options' setting is not provided, a malicious user may be able to overlay their own UI on top of the site by using an iframe.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
rules.description: A jQuery plugin that unintentionally constructs HTML from some of its options may be unsafe to use for clients.

rules.cwe_name: Access of Resource Using Incompatible Type ('Type Confusion')
rules.description: Sanitizing an HTTP request parameter may be ineffective if the user controls its type.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Resource Identifiers ('Resource Injection')
rules.description: creating arbitrary environment variables from user controlled data is not secure

rules.cwe_name: Use of Potentially Dangerous Function
rules.description: The 'eval' function and the 'Function' constructor execute strings as code. This is dangerous and impedes program analysis and understanding. Consequently, these two functions should not be used.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
rules.description: Modifying an object obtained via a user-controlled property name may lead to accidental mutation of the built-in Object prototype, and possibly escalate to remote code execution or cross-site scripting.

rules.cwe_name: Excessive Iteration
rules.description: Iterating over an object with a user-controlled .length property can cause indefinite looping.

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Type Conversion or Cast
rules.description: An attempt to use a value that is not an object or 'null' as a prototype will either be ignored or result in a runtime error.

rules.cwe_name: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
rules.description: Allowing writes to arbitrary properties of an object may lead to denial-of-service attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Use of Externally-Controlled Format String
rules.description: Using external input in format strings can lead to garbled output.

rules.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
rules.description: Attacker-controlled object keys modify Object prototype attributes.

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Web Functionality from an Untrusted Source
rules.description: Using a resource from an untrusted or compromised domain makes your code vulnerable to receiving malicious code.

rules.cwe_name: Incorrect Comparison
rules.description: A security-relevant comparison checks the wrong, incomplete, or non-canonical value.
